verdict.rationale: EFTPS documents only a thin slice of delegated access. A tax-professional role can make payments for multiple clients under a single login through the Batch Provider program, and taxpayers are pointed to tax professionals or payroll providers to pay for them. It does not publish a full statement of what a third party may or may not do. Missing for 10: published authorization/enrollment forms for third-party access, defined role boundaries and prohibited actions, which signatures or actions stay personal to the taxpayer, and independent corroboration.
